title: A Thousand Years in One Shoe

pre.en: Who is Mrs Taylor to the guide?
pre.zh: Taylor 太太和讲解员是什么关系？

intro: 一篇讲解稿：约克约维克维京中心的讲解员 Becky 拿着一只千年旧鞋的复制品，给一组游客讲五分钟。讲解有开场招呼，有「我先讲……再讲……」的路标，结尾一句话把人带到下一站。读的时候留意转述说法：It is said to be …、it is thought that …，和 be supposed to（按说应该）。

sentences.en: Right, good morning, everyone.
sentences.zh: 好，大家早上好。

sentences.en: I'm Becky, and welcome to Jorvik.
sentences.zh: 我是 Becky，欢迎来到约维克。

sentences.en: If you can't hear me at the back, please speak up, because the next group is right behind us.
sentences.zh: 后面要是听不见，请大声说一下，因为下一组游客就紧跟在我们后面。

sentences.en: Today's tour is fully booked, so let's get started.
sentences.zh: 今天的导览名额全满了，我们这就开始吧。

sentences.en: The people on the stairs can catch up.
sentences.zh: 楼梯上的朋友可以跟上来。

sentences.en: So, first I'll tell you where this shoe was found, and then what it tells us about life in Viking York.
sentences.zh: 我先讲这只鞋是在哪儿发现的，再讲它能告诉我们维京时代的约克人怎么过日子。

sentences.en: Now, this is a copy of a small leather shoe, and the real one is kept upstairs.
sentences.zh: 来，这是一只小皮鞋的复制品，真品放在楼上。

sentences.en: It was found in one piece in the 1970s, about six metres under the street we're standing on.
sentences.zh: 它是上世纪七十年代出土的，完完整整，就在我们脚下这条街大约六米深的地方。

sentences.en: It's said to be about a thousand years old.
sentences.zh: 据说它大约有一千年的历史。

sentences.en: It's made of goat leather, and it's a size four.
sentences.zh: 它是山羊皮做的，四码。

sentences.en: That's why it's thought that it belonged to a teenager.
sentences.zh: 正因为这样，人们认为它的主人是个十几岁的孩子。

sentences.en: In those days, hardly anyone wrote anything down.
sentences.zh: 那个年代，几乎没人会把事情记下来。

sentences.en: So keep in mind that a lot of this is a good guess.
sentences.zh: 所以大家要记住，这里面很多都是有根据的猜测。

sentences.en: You know, Vikings are often said to be dirty.
sentences.zh: 大家常听人说维京人很脏。

sentences.en: But actually, hundreds of combs were found here at Coppergate.
sentences.zh: 可实际上，在铜门街这儿出土了好几百把梳子。

sentences.en: Shoes were supposed to last for years, and most ordinary families couldn't afford a new pair every winter.
sentences.zh: 那时候一双鞋是要穿好多年的，大多数普通人家也没钱每年冬天买双新的。

sentences.en: So they made do with what they had.
sentences.zh: 所以只能有什么将就着用什么。

sentences.en: Believe it or not, the owner had this one mended at least three times.
sentences.zh: 说出来你们可能不信，这只鞋的主人至少找人补过三次。

sentences.en: It was only thrown away when it finally wore out.
sentences.zh: 直到彻底穿坏了，才被扔掉。

sentences.en: Are we all on the same page so far?
sentences.zh: 到这儿大家都跟上了吧？

sentences.en: Good, because if you get into Viking history after today, the shop sells a great book.
sentences.zh: 很好，因为今天之后要是你们迷上了维京历史，商店里有本很棒的书。

sentences.en: And no, I don't get paid to say that.
sentences.zh: 先说好，我可不是收了钱才这么说的。

sentences.en: OK, that's my five minutes.
sentences.zh: 好，我的五分钟到了。

sentences.en: Next are the Viking toilets, which are more exciting than they sound.
sentences.zh: 下一站是维京人的厕所，比听起来有意思多了。

sentences.en: Any questions?
sentences.zh: 有问题吗？

sentences.en: Ah, Mrs Taylor at the back is shaking her head.
sentences.zh: 啊，后面的 Taylor 老师在摇头。

sentences.en: She taught me history in 1999.
sentences.zh: 1999 年她教过我历史。

sentences.en: Apparently, I've still got the date wrong.
sentences.zh: 看来，我到现在还是把年份说错了。

cards.note: to speak more loudly so that people can hear you
if a train, hotel or restaurant is fully booked, there are no seats or rooms left
cards.tip: 主语是火车、酒店、餐厅、活动，不是人；也可以说 booked up。
cards.example: Sorry, we're fully booked on Saturday night.

cards.note: to talk to someone you have not seen for a while and hear their news
八到十一世纪从北欧来的人，曾占领约克，叫它 Jorvik；放在名词前也当形容词用。
放在名词前当形容词：a leather bag、leather shoes。

cards.tip: 也常用来说人「平安无事」：They got home in one piece.
cards.example: The package arrived in one piece.

cards.note: to have something as its material
cards.tip: 看得出原材料用 made of（皮鞋、木桌）；看不出了用 made from：Paper is made from wood。
cards.example: The table is made of old wood from a farmhouse.

cards.note: 绵羊是 sheep；goat leather 就是山羊皮。
不用进行时：不说 It is belonging to me。
at a time in the past
cards.tip: 和第 4 课的 these days（如今）相对；说过去的情况，动词用过去时。
cards.example: In those days, nobody had a mobile phone.

cards.note: to remember a fact when you are thinking or making a decision
cards.tip: 后面可以接 that 从句；宾语是短名词时也说 keep sth in mind。
cards.example: Keep in mind that the shop closes at five.

cards.note: b 不发音，读作 /kəʊm/；当动词是「梳」：comb your hair。
to manage with something that is not as good as you want, because there is nothing better
cards.tip: 后面接名词；make 的过去式 made：made do with。没有宾语时可以只说 make do。
cards.example: There's no milk, so we'll have to make do with black coffee.

cards.zh: 信不信由你；说来你可能不信
cards.note: used before saying something surprising but true
cards.tip: 常放在句首，后面加逗号；讲解、讲故事时用来抓住听众。
cards.example: Believe it or not, I've never seen the sea.

cards.note: 多用于衣服、鞋这类东西；修机器、电器常说 fix 或 repair。
to become thin or damaged after being used a lot
cards.tip: wear 的过去式 wore，过去分词 worn：worn out。人也可以 be worn out（累坏了）。
cards.example: My running shoes wore out after six months.

cards.zh: 想法一致；（对情况）理解一致
cards.note: to understand a situation in the same way as other people

cards.zh: 开始喜欢上；迷上（某爱好）
cards.note: to start to be interested in an activity
cards.tip: 后面接名词或 doing：get into cooking；问人怎么入的门：How did you get into it?
cards.example: I got into running during the summer.
